scope: Paper I N=3, stationary linearized axisymmetric reflection-even sector, epsilon=1/100, X0=0, zero remaining controls; one interval-local forward solution germ

theorem.reference: Manuel Eberl, Hermite_Lindemann, Archive of Formal Proofs
theorem.physical_argument: q=1/(10*r0) is positive rational, algebraic and outside {0,i,-i}; T0 is the real arctan(q)
theorem.transfer: Evaluation at T0 embeds Q(T) in R after a defined radial specialization r=r0

required_inputs: hash-pinned original stationary operators and labels
hash-pinned candidate snapshot with producing and upstream identities
ordered state labels, ordered free rows and discarded response definition
total_derivative: Form D=partial_r-10/(100*r^2+1)*partial_T before substituting r=r0 or T=t_star
required_field_identities: (E0 Pv+E1 Pw+E2 Pw K)M=0 on all 22 retained rows including X0
Independently lift the original discarded row d=D0 Pv+D1 Pw+D2 Pw K and compute dM

responding_certificate.pair: One positive rational r0 in the physical domain and one rational t_star, shared by denominator, minor and response checks
denominator_coverage: all original fixed operator coefficients in the three orders including the retained and discarded rows before gauge-column removal
C, K, B, M and original coefficient domain restrictions, including canceled input factors unless analytic extension has independent justification
the total derivative factor, DC, S, profile lift, retained and discarded lifted operators and products on M
all other denominators or divisions used in the proof, including minor and response evaluation
responding_certificate.denominator_evidence: Replayable inventory of exact denominator polynomials, source locations and nonzero rational evaluations at the pair
responding_certificate.minor_evidence: Six distinct original C column indices, exact 6x6 evaluated entries or replayable pinned references, and exact nonzero rational determinant
responding_certificate.response_evidence: Column j in the ordered 8-column dM and exact nonzero rational evaluation of its numerator with verified denominator, or of the defined quotient
responding_certificate.local_argument: Continuity preserves regularity and the minor on one open interval. im(M)=ker(C), S=LC with L=S[:,P] inverse(C[:,P]), and h=Cz obeys h'=Lh, h(r0)=0. The profile lift and all 22 field identities then hold along z'=Kz.

required_controls: Reject r0 outside the positive physical radial domain and inexact evaluation data.
P=r-a at r0=a specializes identically to zero: changing only t_star cannot certify this P.
P=T-b at t_star=b vanishes at one dummy point: retry is allowed and this does not prove a zero physical response.
Reject evaluation at any required zero denominator, including a hidden input restriction after cancellation.
Reject a singular original minor or a zero selected response as positive evidence; exercise a nonsingular original minor requiring a row swap.
Reject mixed-radius or mixed-pair positive evidence and a physical initial datum evaluated at t_star.
Require formal identities over Q(r,T) independently of dummy-point success.

outcomes.responding_forward_germ: Requires every field identity and all nonvanishing checks at the common pair.
outcomes.exact_zero_on_forward_family: A separate formal dM=0 check bounds silence to the forward family.

excluded_claims: final Dirac classification or degree-of-freedom count
